models.name: MiniCPM-V 4.7

engines.hardware: NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, 128GB unified memory), shared with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
engines.quant: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B SAGE EXL3 3.74 bpw as the worker model under Hermes Agent, shared Q4 KV pool of 1,048,576 tokens over 8 concurrent 131K workers; ~69.8 tok/s while the main model is loaded but idle, 40.0 tok/s with both models generating

models.why: A 35B-A3B worker model kept loaded beside a 125B main model on ONE DGX Spark under ExLlamaV3: ~69.8 tok/s idle-neighbour decode, 40.0 tok/s with both generating, serving eight concurrent subagents off a shared 1M-token KV pool instead of eight model copies.
